about: Golden inputs for the assistant intent question (src/ai/decision-questions.ts). Each request is what a person wrote after @assistant. `expect` is the handler it should reach when all three are offered; `either` lists acceptable handlers for judgement calls. The live check asserts the handler, never exact probabilities.
